title: Design: Add Range adds a new last range
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, three ranges.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Click Add Range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • A new row appears at the bottom as the new "and up" range, highlighted, and the row above gets an end, as in picture 4.20.
